metaTitle: Custom Gray Embroidered Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gray embroidered patches in bulk for uniforms, teams, or events. Fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray embroidered patches offer a neutral, professional backdrop that makes your logo or text stand out without competing colors. Perfect for corporate uniforms, safety vests, or team apparel, gray patches pair well with any garment color from navy to black. Choose from standard twill or premium felt backing, and add a border thread for extra definition. Bulk orders benefit from consistent thread density and color matching across every patch.
heroAltText: Custom gray embroidered patches with white border stitching on a twill background, ideal for uniforms and branding.
